payload.thirtySeconds: KeithK75 won the net race at Muirfield Village by three shots over IUDoc92, with MattF and Dan94 hanging around but never really threatening. Keith also took gross, because apparently the rest of the field showed up to donate balls to the water and trees while he posted the cleanest tee-to-green number in the room and turned the place into a personal range session.
payload.latestTournamentTeaser: KeithK75 mops Muirfield Village while everybody else feeds the rough
payload.stateOfLeague: KeithK75 keeps looking like the class of this rolling stretch: he’s now the net and gross guy until somebody proves otherwise. The bigger question is whether the middle of the pack can stop turning every tough course into a survival demo, because the gap between competent ball-striking and whatever that was underneath him is getting stupid.
